title: GearHud
description: Compact HUD showing the durability of your armor, main hand, and off hand as color-coded bars so a tool or armor piece never breaks by surprise.
body:
# GearHud

GearHud puts a small, clean durability readout next to your hotbar so you always know how much life your gear has left - no more accidentally breaking an enchanted tool or losing an armor piece mid-fight.

## Features
- Durability bars for all four armor pieces, your main hand, and your off hand
- Color-coded from green to yellow to red as items wear down
- Low-durability emphasis so near-broken items stand out at a glance
- Optional numeric or percentage readout
- Fully configurable position, layout (horizontal/vertical), and scale

## How to use
Equip armor and tools and the HUD appears automatically. Open the settings (ModMenu ? GearHud) to reposition it or change what's shown.

## Requirements
- Fabric API
- Yet Another Config Lib (YACL)

Client-side only - safe on any server.
